privacyPolicy.metaDescription: Learn how Frevia collects, protects, and manages your personal data and privacy rights.
privacyPolicy.title: Frevia Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: This policy explains how Frevia collects, uses, protects, and handles your personal information across our freelance marketplace platform.
privacyPolicy.tocFooterPrompt: Need to request data export or deletion? Contact
privacyPolicy.commitmentBody: We do not sell, rent, or monetize your personal data to third parties for independent marketing or advertising. Your information is used strictly to operate the platform, facilitate work contracts, and protect financial transactions.

principles.title: Privacy Principles & Scope
principles.p1: This Privacy Policy applies to all users (including Freelancers, Clients, and Visitors) interacting with the Frevia platform.
principles.p2: We process personal data based on lawful grounds: your consent upon account registration, the performance of contracts to which you are party, and compliance with anti-fraud legal requirements.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.card1Body: Full name, email address, bcrypt password hash, selected primary role, avatar image, email OTP verification codes, and linked Google OAuth account details.
collection.card2Body: Professional headline, biography, hourly rate, skills taxonomy, work experience history, education history, portfolio showcase items, and uploaded CV/resume files.
collection.card3Body: Government-issued identity documents (front/back photos) and verification selfies voluntarily submitted by users to verify identity and earn verified platform badges.
collection.card4Body: Job listings, proposals, milestone contract terms, deliverable submission files, Stripe customer/payment intent IDs, and invoice records. Frevia never stores raw payment card numbers.
collection.card5Body: Direct messages exchanged between clients and freelancers, shared project files, forum posts, comments, likes, and community reports.
collection.card6Body: IP address, device type, browser user agent, session tokens, login history, and access timestamps.

usage.title: How We Use Personal Information
usage.item1Body: Authenticating accounts, displaying professional profiles, and matching freelancers with client job posts.
usage.item2Body: Executing milestone contracts, escrow holding and payout via Stripe, deliverable tracking, and invoicing.
usage.item3Body: Using project submissions and communications to fairly arbitrate disputes between clients and freelancers.
usage.item4Body: Analyzing CV skills and project metadata to generate intelligent job and talent recommendations.
usage.item5Body: Detecting banned keywords, preventing spam, unauthorized access, and malicious activity.

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Service Providers
thirdParties.intro: Frevia collaborates with industry-leading infrastructure partners to guarantee data integrity and security:
thirdParties.stripeBody: Processes card transactions, payouts, and milestone holds in strict compliance with PCI-DSS Level 1 security standards.
thirdParties.cloudinaryBody: Provides secure cloud storage for avatars, portfolio media, CV files, and milestone deliverables.
thirdParties.googleBody: Enables secure single sign-on authentication when selected by the user.

security.title: Data Security & Retention
security.p1: We employ strict security measures: TLS/HTTPS transport encryption, irreversible bcrypt password hashing, role-based access control (RBAC), and verified session tokens.
security.p2: Retention Period: Account data is retained for the duration of active service. Invoices and completed contract records are archived to comply with accounting and anti-fraud regulations.

userRights.title: Your Rights & Choices
userRights.item1Body: You can view and modify your profile details, skills, and notification settings anytime in your Account Settings.
userRights.item2Body: You can audit all active device sessions and revoke access immediately for any unrecognized login.
userRights.item3Body: You may request permanent account deletion provided you have no active contracts or pending dispute proceedings.

cookies.title: Cookies & Session Management
cookies.intro: Frevia uses only essential cookies necessary for foundational platform operation:
cookies.accessTokenBody: Secures authentication state across page transitions.
cookies.localeThemeBody: Remembers your preferred language (EN or VI) and UI theme (Light or Dark).

userAgreement.title: Freelancer User Agreement
userAgreement.subtitle: This User Agreement outlines the terms and conditions governing your use of the Frevia platform for project matching, milestone-based contracts, Stripe payments, and community interactions.
userAgreement.tocFooterPrompt: Questions regarding these terms? Contact us at
userAgreement.noticeBody: By checking 'I agree to the Freelancer User Agreement and Privacy Policy' during registration, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to be bound by all provisions set forth herein.

overview.title: Overview & Marketplace Model
overview.p1: Frevia operates an online curated marketplace facilitating connections between independent Freelancers (service providers) and Clients (employers and business clients) for project engagements.
overview.p2: Independent Contractor Relationship: Freelancers are independent contractors and not employees, agents, or partners of Frevia or Clients. Nothing in this Agreement creates an employment, agency, or partnership relationship.
overview.p3: Frevia provides matching systems, milestone-based contract templates, secure payment mediation, and dispute arbitration to ensure transparent and safe transactions.

eligibility.title: Eligibility & Account Security
eligibility.item1Body: You must be at least 18 years old and capable of forming legally binding contracts.
eligibility.item2Body: Each account requires a verified email address via OTP or secure Google OAuth. Passwords are encrypted with bcrypt hashing.
eligibility.item3Body: You can monitor active sessions and remotely revoke unauthorized device sessions in your Account Settings.
eligibility.item4Body: Freelancers may submit government-issued identification documents and verification photos to obtain verified badges, preventing fraud and impersonation.

profiles.title: Freelancer Profiles & Portfolios
profiles.p1: Freelancers are responsible for providing truthful, accurate, and up-to-date information regarding their professional title, skill taxonomy, work experience, and rates.
profiles.p2: All portfolio items and project samples uploaded must represent the freelancer's original work or work they hold legitimate license to showcase.
profiles.p3: CV Analysis & AI Matching: Frevia parses uploaded CV documents to extract skills and improve job recommendations. Significant profile revisions are subject to moderation.

jobsProposals.title: Job Postings & Proposals
jobsProposals.p1: Clients post job requisitions specifying scope of work, category taxonomy, required skills, and expected budget.
jobsProposals.p2: Freelancers submit proposals detailing pricing, delivery estimates, proposed milestone splits, and supporting attachments. Both parties may communicate via Frevia's messaging system.

contractsMilestones.title: Milestone Contracts & Deliverables
contractsMilestones.p1: Contracts on Frevia operate under defined Milestones. Each milestone specifies deliverable outcomes, deadlines, and allocated payment amounts.
contractsMilestones.p2: Submissions: Freelancers upload completed work files and progress notes through the milestone submission portal for client acceptance.
contractsMilestones.p3: Client Review: Clients must review deliverables in good faith and either release milestone funds or request revisions aligned with the agreed scope.

payments.title: Payments via Stripe & Escrow
payments.item1Body: All payments are processed securely via Stripe. Frevia never stores raw credit card details or CVVs on its servers.
payments.item2Body: Clients fund the milestone via Stripe prior to work commencement. Funds are held in escrow and released to the freelancer upon client approval.
payments.item3Body: Bypassing Frevia or Stripe to conduct off-platform payments for engagements originated on the platform is strictly prohibited and results in immediate account suspension.
payments.item4Body: Digital invoices and transaction receipts are automatically generated upon successful milestone payouts.

disputes.title: Dispute Resolution & Arbitration
disputes.p1: If a client and freelancer cannot reach agreement regarding deliverables or payment release, either party may formally initiate a Dispute.
disputes.p2: Arbitration Process: Both parties submit evidence (files, messages, contract specifications). Frevia arbitration staff conducts an objective review and issues a final, binding decision (full payout, refund, or proportionate allocation).

conduct.title: Code of Conduct & Community Forum
conduct.p1: Users agree to interact professionally and courteously. Harassment, abusive language, fraud, malware distribution, phishing, and spam are strictly prohibited.
conduct.p2: Community Moderation: Inappropriate forum posts or comments may be flagged by users for review, and moderators reserve the right to remove content or ban offending accounts.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property Rights
intellectualProperty.p1: Work Product Ownership: Upon complete release of milestone payments, all intellectual property rights in custom deliverables produced for the client transfer to the Client.
intellectualProperty.p2: Pre-existing IP: Freelancers retain ownership of their pre-existing frameworks and retain portfolio display rights unless restricted by a specific Non-Disclosure Agreement.
intellectualProperty.p3: Frevia Platform IP: Frevia trademarks, brand logos, user interface designs, and platform codebase remain the exclusive property of Frevia.

termination.title: Termination & General Terms
termination.p1: Frevia reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that breach this Agreement, engage in financial fraud, or jeopardize marketplace integrity.
termination.p2: Limitation of Liability: The platform is provided 'as is' and 'as available'. Frevia disclaims indirect or consequential damages to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law.
